<subject>Re: [ORG_1]</subject>
<body>
Adam:

We told James Austin that we would release our [LOC_1] and the Opinion at closing on Wednesday. They were okay with that. If that's a problem, I can fax the guaranty and opinion (once I have it signed), with a letter from me saying you can't release it until funding...
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au
Sent: Tuesday, 30 April 2024 9:59 AM
To: l157@norcorco.com; kenneth.lee@tasmanridge.com.au
Cc: vincent.james@tasmanridge.com.au; todd.vaughan@tasmanridge.com.au
Subject: [ORG_1]

Good morning.

In order to finish up IronCliff Logistics tomorrow, please note we need the following today:

Tasman Ridge parent guaranty  
A$8.2M bank LOC (so that full payment can be made to Norcorco tomorrow)  
Opinion of counsel  

And once funds are received by Norcorco, we need the receipt of funds letter.

Matthew, I haven't heard back from the Port Hedland gang to find out if the WestPilbara Gen contract is ready. Maybe Jake can help shake that loose.

Thanks,

Adam
</quoted>
